Must try in Nihn Bihn
Nov 2025 • Couples
This might be the best food I’ve had in this little city. The family who runs the restaurant is incredibly respectful and never tries to scam you, unlike some other places in the area. It’s a small, cozy spot, and the beef or chicken pho is an absolute must-try. If you want to explore more dishes, the morning glory and stir-fried pho are also delicious.

We stayed in Ninh Binh for two days and ended up eating here for three out of our six meals — that alone should tell you how much we loved it.

Riquísimo! Amazing!
Dec 2024 • Couples
Super rico! It was amazing!
Comimos phò de cabra y unos noodles de ternera y todo estaba riquísimo. Nos trataron genial, nos regalaron un par de plátanos de su huerta (sin pesticidas) y un licor tradicional y estaba espectacular!
El ambiente es muy familiar y acogedor, un clásico en Vietnam, pero que quizás hemos echado de menos en TamCoc, por la masificación turística. Volveremos!
-----------
We had goat pho and beef noodles and everything was delicious. They treated us great, they gave us a couple of bananas from their garden (without pesticides) and a traditional liquor and it was spectacular!
The atmosphere is very familiar and welcoming, a classic in Vietnam, but perhaps we have missed it in TamCoc, due to the tourist masses. We will return!
